tooltip.deepdiving.cylinder_use: Use in air: wear | Sneak-use in air: toggle backup
deepdiving.ponder.blender.text_1: Feed oxygen into the blue-marked port, nitrogen into the green-marked port, and helium into the top inlet.
deepdiving.ponder.blender.text_2: Select Air, Nitrox, Trimix or Heliox in the menu. Oxygen and helium can also be adjusted in 1% steps.
deepdiving.ponder.blender.text_3: A cylinder containing a different mixture must be purged first. Filling only consumes gas when every required constituent is available.
deepdiving.ponder.blender.text_4: Wear the filled cylinder and Create diving helmet. Carry a regulator and computer; enable inventory backups with sneak-use.
deepdiving.ponder.compressor.text_1: Supply at least 16 RPM through the rear shaft. More speed produces and fills gas faster.
deepdiving.ponder.compressor.text_2: Keep the top intake above water. Use Create pipes and pumps to extract compressed air.
deepdiving.ponder.compressor.text_3: Insert a cylinder into the input slot. Filled cylinders leave through the output slot; a bottom hopper can extract them.
deepdiving.ponder.separator.text_1: Feed compressed air into the top inlet and power the rear shaft.
deepdiving.ponder.separator.text_2: Oxygen exits the blue-marked port; nitrogen exits the green-marked port. Each 100 mB air batch becomes 21 mB oxygen and 79 mB nitrogen.
deepdiving.ponder.separator.text_3: Feed compressed air from a compressor. Empty storage vessels do not generate gas. Attach separate vessels directly, or use powered Create pumps and pipes.
deepdiving.ponder.storage.text_1: Each vessel holds up to 64000 mB of one gas. All faces support Create pipes and pumps.
deepdiving.ponder.storage.text_2: Insert expensive helium cartridges to release 1000 mB helium each. A vessel containing another gas will reject the cartridge.
deepdiving.ponder.storage.text_3: Engineer's Goggles and Display Links report gas quantities. Sneak-wrench pickup preserves the gas and inventory.

death.attack.deepdiving.pressure.item: %1$s was crushed by the deep while escaping %2$s wielding %3$s
effect.deepdiving.hypoxia.cause: Too little oxygen reaches your breathing reserve.
effect.deepdiving.hypoxia.recovery: Restore a suitable breathing gas or reach air. Oxygen reserve recovers gradually.
effect.deepdiving.narcosis.cause: Your breathing gas has too much narcotic pressure at this depth.
effect.deepdiving.narcosis.recovery: Move shallower without exceeding the ascent limit or crossing your stop ceiling.
effect.deepdiving.oxygen_toxicity.cause: Oxygen pressure is too high for your current breathing gas.
effect.deepdiving.oxygen_toxicity.recove: Use a suitable mixture or move shallower within your ascent and stop limits. Exposure fades slowly.
effect.deepdiving.decompression_sickness: Rapid pressure reduction has caused decompression stress.
Follow the computer stop depth and NEXT estimate with suitable gas. A cleared stop does not instantly remove existing sickness.
effect.deepdiving.pressure_injury.cause: Water pressure exceeded your worn equipment rating.
effect.deepdiving.pressure_injury.recove: Reach pressure within your equipment rating, respecting ascent and stop limits. Injury heals gradually.
effect.deepdiving.blackout.cause: Severe oxygen deficit or oxygen exposure has caused unconsciousness.
effect.deepdiving.blackout.recovery: A suitable gas must restore oxygen and reduce exposure before consciousness returns.
advancement.deepdiving.root.title: Create: Deep Diving
advancement.deepdiving.root.description: Carry a diving regulator to begin preparing your equipment.
advancement.deepdiving.ready_to_dive.des: Wear a Create diving helmet and filled cylinder, and carry a regulator and computer.
advancement.deepdiving.first_dive.title: First Breath Below
advancement.deepdiving.first_dive.descri: Take your prepared equipment underwater with gas suitable for the depth.
advancement.deepdiving.backup_ready.desc: Carry a regulator and a filled spare with inventory backup enabled.
deepdiving.ponder.equipment.text_1: Wear a Create diving helmet and a filled cylinder in your chest slot.
deepdiving.ponder.equipment.text_2: Carry a regulator in your inventory. The helmet and cylinder need it to supply gas.
deepdiving.ponder.equipment.text_3: Sneak-use a filled spare to enable backup. It takes over when your worn supply empties.
deepdiving.ponder.equipment.text_4: Carry a computer for the HUD; use it for gas time, ascent guidance and recovery help.
deepdiving.ponder.equipment.text_5: Check both the cylinder pressure rating and gas depth range. A spare supplies gas, but does not protect your body.
message.deepdiving.hold_enabled: Depth hold enabled. Swim up, sneak, or press the hotkey again to release.
message.deepdiving.hold_unavailable: Depth hold needs diving gear, a computer, and breathing gas underwater.
message.deepdiving.hold_below_stop: Descend to at least %s blocks before holding depth.
tooltip.deepdiving.cylinder_place: Use on a block: place | Empty hand: pick up
message.deepdiving.orbit_camera: Orbit view: mouse rotates the camera, scroll zooms, %s exits. Swimming direction stays unchanged.
